trial_fit.task: Is the patient ELIGIBLE for the trial? (TREC label 2 vs 0/1)
trial_fit.data: TREC Clinical Trials, patient topics + assessor judgments; train 2021, test 2022 (different topics)
trial_fit.pool: Sampled, <=15 pairs per label per topic. Metrics describe ranking within this balanced pool.
limitations: Trial text is the current registry version, not the 2021 snapshot the assessors saw.
TREC patients are synthetic case descriptions.

completion.data: 8435 real colorectal patients from cBioPortal (MSK 2017/2026, SYSUCC 2022, TCGA)
limitations: Cohorts are US (MSK, TCGA) and Chinese (SYSUCC); no Thai patients are included.
Predicts a likely result; it is not a substitute for the test. The platform still marks the criterion Unknown.
Cross-validation is internal; no external validation cohort.

inventory.name: TCGA PanCancer Atlas colorectal

inventory.name: ClinicalTrials.gov: recruiting colorectal trials
inventory.what: title, phase, sponsor, sites, full eligibility text

inventory.name: TREC Clinical Trials 2021 + 2022
